BiblicalUsage: Eli is an Israelite. In 1 Kings 2:27, the text says "which he spake concerning the house of Eli in Shiloh." The life behind the name is told on the Eli People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eli matters because God knows His people by name, and Eli is one of them. That is why I want the name, and the person behind it, kept straight.
